brief.audience: a layperson (the /build lay-reader default), in English or Khmer
brief.where: inline on heartbank.org (top of the page, beside the headline) and on demo.heartbank.org/Explainer.html and ExplainerKm.html
brief.mechanism: A coin and a thank-you travel straight between two people while a shared card records the thanks; the receiver keeps half and passes half on.

budget.note: inline SVG + one small script; no video, no image, no font beyond the page's own

doctrine: Nothing is animated as a loss, and the picture carries no meter, progress bar, rank or count of people; no water; the figures are drawn, not real; no model is named. It plays once and rests on its last frame, with a Play-again button, never a loop.

s1.en: Two people. One gives money, with a thank-you.
s1.km: មនុស្សពីរនាក់។ ម្នាក់ឲ្យប្រាក់ ជាមួយពាក្យអរគុណ។

s2.en: The thanks is written in a shared record.
s2.km: ការអរគុណត្រូវបានសរសេរក្នុងកំណត់ត្រារួម។

s3.en: The receiver keeps half and passes half on to a third person.
s3.km: អ្នកទទួលទុកពាក់កណ្តាល ហើយឲ្យពាក់កណ្តាលទៀតបន្តទៅមនុស្សទីបី។

s4.en: The ring closes. Thanks keep moving.
s4.km: រង្វង់បិទ។ ការអរគុណបន្តធ្វើដំណើរ។

replay.km: លេងម្តងទៀត

alt.en: Two people and an elder in a ring: a coin and a heart pass between them while a shared card records the thanks.
alt.km: មនុស្សបីនាក់ជារង្វង់៖ កាក់ និងបេះដូងឆ្លងកាត់ពួកគេ ហើយប័ណ្ណរួមកត់ត្រាការអរគុណ។
